candidates.name: Purpura Fulminans
support_spans: He had 24 h of scrotal pain and swelling before surgery
The tips of his fingers and toes appeared cyanosed bilaterally
Ecchymoses were present over the extremities, and he bled easily from puncture sites
cyanosis of fingers and toes progressed to well-demarcated gangrene below the elbows and knees
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of scrotal pain and swelling, cyanosis, ecchymoses, and progression to gangrene are consistent with Purpura Fulminans, a rare disorder characterized by rapid progression of hemorrhagic necrosis of the skin.
